description: Transcribe an audio recording (URL or base64, at most 25 MB) to text, in chunks. 5 credits (EUR 0.05) per successful call; needs a bearer token.

audioBase64.description: Base64 audio payload (with or without a data: prefix). One source required.

audioUrl.description: Public https URL of the audio file (mp3/m4a/wav). One source required.

name: transcribe_and_slice_audio
